title: On the $K$-extensions between Serre weights for unramified $\mathrm{GL}_3$
summary: Let $p\geq5$ be a prime number. Let $L$ be a finite unramified extension of $\mathbb{Q}_p$ with ring of integers $\mathcal{O}_L$ and residue field $\mathbb{F}_q$. Given two Serre weights for $\mathrm{GL}_3(\mathbb{F}_q)$, we prove that in most cases the extensions between them for $\mathrm{GL}_3(\mathcal{O}_L)$ modulo the center coincide with their $\mathrm{GL}_3(\mathbb{F}_q)$-extensions.
